text:
ana: Quick dump from profiler on prod (2h sample). Two clear workload modes: short prompts (<32 tokens) with very high decode rate (>120 tok/s) and long prompts (>512) with slow decode. Thinking we should move to a 2D workload classifier (prompt_length_bucket x decode_rate_bucket) to pick token_budget, admission target, and a kernel_hint for each class.

ana: Rough buckets I used in a local poke: prompt_buckets = [<=32, 33-128, 129-512, >512]; decode_buckets = [<=30, 31-120, >120]. That yields 12 buckets but most traffic falls into 6. For each (p,d) pair we can set: token_budget, target_batch_fill, kernel_hint, kv_keep_ratio. Thoughts? Concerns: KV cache thrash for prefix-heavy flows, and too many pools causing queue fragmentation.

ryan.s: +1 to 2D classifier. My main worry is pool explosion and small-population buckets starving. Prefer folding very-low-volume (<=0.5% traffic) combos into nearest neighbor buckets. Also add a global cap on simultaneous pools.

ryan.s: Example config sketch:

```json
{
  "classifier_v3": {
    "prompt_buckets": [32, 128, 512],
    "decode_buckets": [30, 120],
    "fold_threshold_pct": 0.5,
    "max_active_pools": 9,
    "mappings": {
      "short_high": {"token_budget": 256, "target_fill": 0.75, "kernel_hint": "fast_int4", "kv_keep_ratio": 0.25},
      "long_low": {"token_budget": 2048, "target_fill": 0.9, "kernel_hint": "kv_prefetch", "kv_keep_ratio": 0.6} 
    }
  }
}
```

ryan.s: We should also expose a soft-failover: if pool utilization < 10% for 60s, merge it into adjacent pool.

kai_w: On KV: short-high-decode flows benefit from lower kv_keep_ratio (avoid filling large cache for ephemeral prefixes). But prefetching KV for long flows reduces kernel stalls. Suggest dynamic kv_keep_ratio per bucket as in config. Also watch memory blowout on nodes if many 'kv_prefetch' pools live simultaneously.

kai_w: Small perf hint: when kernel_hint="fast_int4", pin to the optimized matmul kernel and prefer fused attention; but add a stability guard so kernels don't flip every few seconds.

perf-bot: automated-run: classifier_v3_poke @ 1772554380 -> results: base p50=24ms p95=180ms, classifier_v3 p50=22ms p95=195ms (+8.3% p95). sample: {"short_high": {"p95_base": 85, "p95_new": 90}, "long_low": {"p95_base": 400, "p95_new": 380}}.

tessa: Noted regressions on a prior rollout: mixed batches caused kernel fallback thrash on A100, leading to +12% p95. We need a kernel_stability_threshold before switching hints. Proposal: only change kernel_hint if new_hint has sustained perf advantage for 30s and >5% improvement. Also prefer batch-level kernel tag so coalesced batches avoid heterogenous kernel selection.

ana: Good points. Action items: I'll open a PR with classifier_v3 config + folding rules + kernel_stability_threshold + canary plan. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 80% with automatic rollback if canary p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.05 for 10m.

ana: I'll also run bench: `bench --workload continuous-batch --config classifier_v3 --runs 300` and post full numbers. tagging for review: @ryan.s @kai_w @tessa :eyes: :party_parrot:
